item.title: Lawsuit filing: Point72's quant unit Cubist claims its fired lead research analyst used Claude and Codex to steal source code before leaving for a competitor (Bloomberg)
item.description: Point72's quantitative unit, Cubist, has filed a lawsuit against a former lead research analyst, alleging that the employee used AI tools like Claude and Codex to steal proprietary source code before jumping to a competitor. This case highlights a new frontier in financial compliance: monitoring internal misuse of generative AI for intellectual property theft.

item.title: SpaceX announces Starlink Mini 2 with a swappable battery that it says can operate for over four hours without an external power source, reportedly for $999 (Andrew Liszewski/The Verge)
item.description: SpaceX has unveiled the Starlink Mini 2, an all-in-one satellite terminal featuring an integrated dish, Wi-Fi router, and a swappable battery. Thinner than its predecessor at 23.1mm, the device offers 4.5 hours of autonomy and is priced at $999, which includes a year of unlimited roaming service for mobile and off-grid users.

item.title: Clara, which sells corporate spend management tools in Latin America, raised $105M, including a $65M Series C and $40M in renewed growth financing (Maria Clara Cobo/Bloomberg)
item.description: São Paulo-based corporate spending startup Clara has raised $105 million, comprising a $65 million Series C round and $40 million in debt growth financing. The fresh capital will be used to scale its corporate expense management operations across Latin America.

item.description: reveal that despite Trump's public denials, he was informed at least twice over seven months regarding allegations of an affair between Huang and a suspected spy. One briefing reportedly occurred during a trip to China while accompanied by Rubio.

item.title: Anthropic turns Claude into a full workspace with Plugins, spreadsheets, whiteboards, and soon Meeting notes
item.description: Anthropic has transformed Claude into a comprehensive workspace by introducing collaboration features such as AI-assisted spreadsheets, interactive whiteboards, and data dashboard integration with tools like Snowflake and Salesforce. A meeting assistant is also slated for imminent release to bolster enterprise productivity.

So to address this, Google Fi is introducing its new super network feature which allows your phone to automatically switch between two different carriers to deliver the best connection possible. To train a robot for new tasks, engineers usually spend hours remotely controlling the machines. This so-called teleoperation is expensive, slow, and needs its own data for every robot model. item.title: Alta, which is building blockchain infrastructure for banks and payment companies, raised a $47.5M Series A, bringing its total funding to $80M (Kyle Baird/The Block)
item.description: Alta, a blockchain infrastructure provider for banks and payment firms, raised $47.5 million in Series A funding led by Index Ventures. Bringing its total funding to $80 million, the company aims to modernize payment and settlement rails for traditional financial institutions.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon arrives just in time to feel like yesterday's news in the fastest model cycle yet
item.description: Google has released Gemini 4 Carbon, a model designed for complex multi-step coding and scientific research, positioning it as a deeper reasoning companion to Argon. However, the model is already losing its luster as Anthropic’s new Fable 5.2 model outperforms it in benchmarks, highlighting an increasingly brutal pace of AI model iteration.

item.title: The AI Futures Project updates its AI timelines after METR's report on Anthropic R&D, saying it now expects a Superhuman AI Researcher to arrive in 2027 (AI Futures Project)
item.description: The AI Futures Project, citing METR's report on Anthropic's R&D pace, has updated its forecast, predicting the arrival of a 'Superhuman AI Researcher' by 2027. The report notes that AI development is currently progressing twice as fast as historical trends, with AI itself driving roughly 80% of this acceleration.

item.title: Oura agrees to acquire AI and on-demand doctor service Counsel Health for $625M, says Q4 revenue grew 153% YoY to $533M and FY 2026 revenue grew 92% to $1.75B (Mark Gurman/Bloomberg)
item.description: Smart ring manufacturer Oura has agreed to acquire the AI-driven on-demand doctor service platform Counsel Health for $625 million. This acquisition aims to bolster Oura's medical diagnostic capabilities beyond mere data tracking, backed by a strong financial performance of 153% YoY growth in Q4 and a 92% increase in total 2026 revenue.

item.description: A background report on Alice Huang details her career path, highlighting her relationship with Hexi Capital founder Kang Wei, who previously faced investigations in the stock market. Sources suggest she has returned to China, while her complex personal history and connections to key figures in the tech sector have drawn significant public scrutiny.

item.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot
item.description: Google DeepMind unveiled the Gemini 2.5 robotic model, integrating vision, language, and motion control to operate diverse hardware like Apptronik robots. In pilot tests at Mercedes-Benz plants, the model achieved a 96% success rate and increased task speed by up to 30%.

item.title: Dreeze, launched by Zerto founders to help companies recover from cyberattacks by restoring entire cloud applications, emerges from stealth with a $33M seed (CTech)
item.description: Founded by the Zerto team, Dreeze emerged from stealth with $33 million in seed funding. The company focuses on recovering entire cloud applications, including infrastructure and configurations, rather than just data, to ensure business continuity after cyberattacks.

item.description: Anthropic revealed in an updated S-1 filing that its seven co-founders plan to sell $1.75 billion worth of stock during next week's IPO. This move allows the founders to cash out, with each taking home approximately $250 million at the offering's midpoint.
